capture.scope: Unchanged149 projection context capture is narrower than public/private output cap. Overflow is explicitly a harness failure with retained raw prefix, never public-cap proof or automatic product bug. Full quota/at-C/masked obligations remain their declared UNRUN/source roles.
capture.storage: Raw process streams spool to exclusive binary files while read; no stdout JSON receipt parser. IPC results are compact and bound; command captures are exclusive files before assertions.

disk.reservationFormula: 336*32MiB combined raw/metadata +180*64MiB retained package copies +512MiB copied tools +512MiB source/archive/build auxiliary trees +512MiB supervisor/other fixed data =23.25GiB <=24GiB
disk.qualification: Harness-owned writes/reservations and exact expected compiler outputs are bounded. This is not an OS filesystem quota, physical allocation/block accounting, hard RSS cap or promise against opaque/malicious host code.

memory.notes: Raw stream spools avoid aggregate stdout buffers. Frozen in-child fixture retains2MiB bytes, hex roughly doubles them, and metadata is independently bounded. Node/TypeScript runtime heap, native zlib and OS scheduling are not hard-RSS/preemption guarantees.

timing.firstAuthReservation: Original supervisor origin, not a later now+120s reset
timing.opaqueHostQualification: A stalled host can delay timers or synchronous filesystem calls; late completion is failure, not extra execution authority.
